name: Taggarr
description: Dub analysis and tagging for media files.

paths.name: TV Path
paths.description: Path to your TV media files for analysis (e.g. /mnt/user/tv)

variables.name: Sonarr - URL
variables.description: URL to your Sonarr instance (e.g. http://sonarr:8989)

variables.name: Sonarr - API Key
variables.description: API key for your Sonarr instance

variables.name: Dry Run
variables.description: Enable dry run mode to see what actions would be taken without making any changes.

variables.name: Tags - Wrong Dub
variables.description: Tag to apply for wrong dubs.

variables.name: Add Tag to Genre
variables.description: Whether to add the tag to the genre.

variables.name: Target Genre
variables.description: Genre to target for analysis (e.g. anime, movie, show).

variables.name: Target Languages
variables.description: Comma-separated list of target languages (e.g. en, fr, ja).

variables.name: Run Interval
variables.description: Interval, in seconds, between runs (default: 7200 seconds = 2 hours)

variables.name: Start Running
variables.description: Whether to start running immediately after container starts.

variables.name: Write Mode
variables.description: Write mode for tags: 0 = None, 1 = Rewrite, 2 = Remove.
